# 3 Axial Skyrmions  
- The reflection alters only one pion field's sign, leading to a relative phase definition of π, differing from refs.[3, 12, 7], where all three pion fields are inverted for the antiSkyrmion.  
- The chosen definition in this paper facilitates a more intuitive comparison with scenarios involving monopoles.  
- The profile function reaches zero at a radius of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, allowing for a seamless connection between them, with fields set to vacuum outside the cores.  
- Beyond the simple ansatz (3.7), more complex initial conditions were applied, derived from the rational map ansatz [11], incorporating an axially symmetric charge n map.
